questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How much babies should eat in their first year
How a woman's relationship with food changes in pregnancy
Why people eat more when they are stressed
Healthy recipes that are completely safe for pregnant women
questions.why: Phil says they'll find out how a woman's relationship to food changes during pregnancy.

questions.q: According to Georgie, who experiences nutritional problems during pregnancy?
options: The mother, because the baby takes what it needs
The baby, because it doesn't get enough food from the mother
Both mother and baby equally
Neither, if the mother eats chips
questions.why: The baby takes the nutrients it needs, so it's the mum-to-be who experiences any problems.

questions.q: How does Jaega Wise describe her body during pregnancy?
options: Stronger and healthier than before
Exactly the same as before
Always tired, but otherwise completely normal
Doing strange things it didn't do before
questions.why: She says her body has gone a bit haywire and is doing things that are frankly weird.

options: She can't sleep at night
She has lost her sense of taste and smell
She gets nosebleeds all the time
She can't stop sneezing
questions.why: She rarely had nosebleeds before pregnancy, but now she seems to get them all the time.

questions.q: Why do some pregnant women feel guilty, according to Georgie?
options: They don't exercise enough
They can't cook healthy meals for themselves
They crave food that isn't very healthy
They eat less than they should
questions.why: When cravings are for food that's not so healthy, some women feel guilty.

questions.q: What is Henrietta Norton's main advice to pregnant women?
options: Stop eating chocolate completely
Be kind to yourself
Follow a strict diet in the first trimester
Eat whatever the baby wants
questions.why: She says the most important thing is “to absolutely be kind to yourself”.

questions.q: Why does Henrietta mention the cat-o'-nine-tails?
options: To describe an old cure for cravings
To show how hard pregnancy was in the past
To warn about a dangerous food
To say women shouldn't punish themselves
questions.why: She says not to “get out the cat-o'-nine-tails” – it's not about giving yourself a hard time.

questions.q: According to Henrietta, why might a woman want to eat chips early in pregnancy?
options: Her body feels it is under physical stress
Chips contain important nutrients
She is bored of healthy food
The baby is growing very fast and needs more fat
questions.why: She says the body is going through what it perceives to be physiological stress.
